label: Thin-existence rival of the existence-to-act contract survives, checked
description: Rival test for the existence-to-act contract against its smallest consumer, Round2ExistenceAct.intellectualExerciseRequiresActFromExistence (premises: every intellectual exerciser exists at the world, the existence-to-act contract). With one existing exerciser in act in no respect, the thin-existence rival holds with the other premise and the conclusion fails. Model-witnessed survival only; the interpretation assigns no act at all, which the rival permits but does not require.

research_comparisons.conditions: Control.thinOntic, thinAct, thinAttribution at the one world: the rival and IntellectualExerciserExistsAt hold; IntellectualExerciseRequiresAct fails. Consumer tested: Round2ExistenceAct.intellectualExerciseRequiresActFromExistence.
research_comparisons.scope: Same Ontic model, InAct, esse and selected world as the premise; one world, one candidate, one respect.
research_comparisons.coverage: One explicitly populated interpretation; the weaker two-category rival (some existents with the act, some without) is not tested.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival and the premise cannot both hold on one model, InAct, esse and world (unregistered helper thinExistence_excludes).
research_comparisons.witness: Control.thinOntic with thinAct and thinAttribution in Control.ThinExistenceSurvives; thinExistenceSurvives proves the listed conjuncts.
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against the adopted concrete-as-esse-in-re sense: with it the rival makes every existent of the world abstract, so it stands or falls with the abstract-only rival of concrete population.
